description: Cart-pole with LQR feedback (4D), finite horizon: the state converges into a box shell around the hanging equilibrium.
notes: The initial set is a single state (degenerate box).

State x = (p, v, theta, omega): cart position and velocity, pole angle (counter-clockwise, zero hanging down, positive with the pole mass towards positive p) and angular velocity; Tedrake's cart-pole as printed. u = -K x is the LQR state feedback (gains k1..k4) designed by scripts/cartpole_lqr.py with Q = diag(56.5349, 27.434, 1.8689, 77.9197), R = 6.6884.

The target is a box shell around the equilibrium (the origin): the box of half-width 0.001 without the open box of half-width 1e-30. The equilibrium itself is excluded, as the time-to-reach bounds assume (x_e not in X_F); the hole is far smaller than the sample spacing, so the target's samples are those of the box.
